items.title: File Widerspruch against the fire-permit refusal
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: The notice is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and was sent by ordinary post by an authority, so under § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG (the Schleswig-Holstein counterpart to § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG) it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Sun 22.11.2026; this day does not shift for the deemed-delivery rule itself. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day (23.11.2026) and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). Since 22.12.2026 is a business day (not a weekend or SH public holiday), no further shift applies. Widerspruch must reach the Amt by this date.

warnings: The letter also mentions an open info session on 29.12.2026 at the Bürgerhaus Ostweide, but it is explicitly described as voluntary and free ('die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und kostenlos'), so it is not an obligation and is not listed as a deadline item.
